hc.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM employees WHERE status = '在职'

turnover.sql: WITH leavers AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM employees WHERE termination_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND termination_date < DATE '2026-01-01'), hc0 AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM employees WHERE hire_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND (termination_date IS NULL OR termination_date >= DATE '2025-01-01')) SELECT round(l.n * 100.0 / h.n, 2) AS v FROM leavers l, hc0 h

cost.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(base_pay + overtime_pay + bonus) / 6, 0) AS v FROM salary_payments WHERE pay_period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06'

hire.sql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM employees WHERE hire_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

funnel.reference_sql: SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = '已入职') * 100.0 / count(*), 1) AS v FROM candidates WHERE applied_at BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

dept.reference_sql: SELECT d.dept_name AS k, count(*) AS v FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE e.status = '在职' GROUP BY d.dept_name

costM.reference_sql: SELECT pay_period AS k, sum(base_pay + overtime_pay + bonus) AS v FROM salary_payments WHERE pay_period >= '2025-01' GROUP BY pay_period

lvl.reference_sql: SELECT job_level AS k, round(avg(base_salary), 0) AS v FROM employees WHERE status = '在职' GROUP BY job_level

attr.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT e.dept_id, count(*) AS lv FROM employees e WHERE e.termination_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND e.termination_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.dept_id), h AS (SELECT e.dept_id, count(*) AS hc FROM employees e WHERE e.hire_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND (e.termination_date IS NULL OR e.termination_date >= DATE '2025-01-01') GROUP BY e.dept_id) SELECT d.dept_name AS k, round(coalesce(l.lv,0) * 100.0 / h.hc, 1) AS v FROM h JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = h.dept_id LEFT JOIN l ON l.dept_id = h.dept_id

leave.sql: SELECT leave_type AS k, sum(days) AS v FROM leave_requests WHERE status = '已批准' AND start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY leave_type

src.sql: SELECT c.source AS k, count(*) AS v FROM candidates c JOIN employees e ON c.hired_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.hire_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31' GROUP BY c.source

gen.reference_sql: SELECT gender AS k, count(*) AS v FROM employees WHERE status = '在职' GROUP BY gender

totalcost.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(s.base_pay + s.overtime_pay + s.bonus + i.company_total) / 60000, 1) AS v, count(*) AS person_months FROM salary_payments s JOIN insurance_payments i ON i.emp_id = s.emp_id AND i.pay_period = s.pay_period JOIN employees e ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE s.pay_period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06'

plan.reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(actual_headcount) * 100.0 / sum(planned_headcount), 1) AS v FROM v_headcount_vs_plan WHERE plan_year = 2025

offer.sql: SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '已接受') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('已接受','已拒绝')), 0), 1) AS v FROM offers WHERE offer_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

eng.sql: SELECT round(avg(engagement_score), 2) AS v FROM engagement_surveys WHERE survey_year = 2025

hp.reference_sql: SELECT dept_name AS k, planned_headcount AS p, actual_headcount AS a FROM v_headcount_vs_plan WHERE plan_year = 2025

costC.reference_sql: SELECT pay_period AS k, sum(base_pay) AS b, sum(overtime_pay) AS o, sum(bonus) AS bo, sum(insurance_company) AS ins FROM v_workforce_monthly WHERE pay_period >= '2025-01' GROUP BY pay_period

rej.sql: SELECT reject_reason AS k, count(*) AS v FROM offers WHERE status = '已拒绝' GROUP BY reject_reason

costPerHire.sql: WITH costs AS (SELECT channel, sum(amount) AS cost FROM recruitment_costs WHERE cost_month LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY channel), hires AS (SELECT c.source, count(*) AS n FROM candidates c JOIN employees e ON c.hired_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.hire_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.source) SELECT costs.channel AS k, costs.cost / NULLIF(hires.n, 0) AS v, coalesce(hires.n, 0) AS n FROM costs LEFT JOIN hires ON hires.source = CASE WHEN costs.channel = '内推奖励' THEN '内推' ELSE costs.channel END

arc.sql: SELECT termination_reason AS k, count(*) AS v FROM employees WHERE status = '离职' GROUP BY termination_reason ORDER BY v DESC, k LIMIT 6

real.sql: SELECT real_reason_category AS k, count(*) AS v FROM exit_interviews GROUP BY real_reason_category ORDER BY v DESC, k LIMIT 6

goal.sql: SELECT d.dept_name AS k, sum(g.completion_pct * g.weight) / sum(g.weight) AS v FROM performance_goals g JOIN employees e ON g.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id WHERE g.review_period = '2026H1' GROUP BY d.dept_name
